With e3 happening this weekend, wanted to see who else was excited. What announcements are you hoping to hear? What games are you most excited about?

 

so far I am excited about assassins creed: origin since this will be set in Egypt, something that really hasn't been explored in video games before. also excited for the announcement of megaman legacy collection 2. I love the megaman games and love just sitting down and playing them. Rather see a new one over a collection but I will deal. Finally I am excited for more details on lego marvel superheroes 2. The lego games may be repetitive but they never get old. Plus my 2 month old has discovered the tv ( his favorite thing to watch is the cubbies beating the cardinals) and hoping the lego games will be something great I can play to help his development.

I *really* want to hear an announcement for Dragon Age 4.  There have been some rumblings on Twitter and the accidental slip that the lead writer behind Sunless Seas was brought on board to work on "a new Dragon Age game", but nothing's been definitively announced yet.

posts.name: LeperKhan
posts.cooked:
Thanks for the info about .hack! Hadn't heard about that yet, so had to search it up after reading.

If Mario Odyssey is really so huge like they claim it is, then I guess that it will be enough to tide fans over until the next big release. The sheer magnitude of Breath of the Wild has definitely kept me from finding a lot of things thus far, and I'm not about to fight the final boss until I have several more shrines under my belt! Mario won't be that big, surely, but they've touted it as being the most expansive Mario game, so I hope it really live up to that. I may not like the concept of Mario wandering around next to normal looking people when he is so cartoonish...or the realistic dinosaur when we obviously know that dinosaurs have a saddle and long tongues...but it's still an instant buy for me because it's a main entry.

posts.name: LeperKhan
posts.cooked: You're right! I guess I'm a little more hesitant about that one because there's not really anything to compare it to. Like...does it just mean a top down Pokemon game with 3d graphics, like Sun and Moon...or does it mean a full-fledged 3d title with wild Doduos running through the plains as you bike by, dodging the peck attacks of the Spearows that are chasing you while fumbling at your belt to grasp at the pokeball containing that quickly-evolved starter that you fell in love with? A 'port' of Sun and Moon (labelled Stars) does not interest me as much as a full, complementary, ground-up Switch RPG.
